author: flyofff
body:
Hey!
I see that I'm temp banned. My brother was playing on my account, and he told me that when he was knocked out, he left the game. Well, I know that my account is my responsibility but, can you at least shorten my ban? Or just tell me what he did as I'll talk to him that way. I'm really sorry about him, AND IM SO FUCKING ANGRY WITH HIM, and please understand me. He wants to play and I can't say no to him but I didn't think that he'd do it. Please help me, and try to understand.


Thanks, Borra!

title: Combat Logging-TempBanned

replies.author: faht
replies.body:
Alright Borrah, I can see that you're lying right here. I was spectating you. You / your brother got knocked out, while falling into the void, you did /leave and joined the other team (yellow) and instantly started to play again. I wont reduce your tempban since it your account, you're responsible for it. This appeal is denied. I'll leave this appeal open for 24 hours incase you have something to say.

Regards,
Jiveh
